source_text:
{A basic model problem arising in magnetostatics seeks a (vector proxy) 2-form $B$ for which}
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}B=f,\qquad\operatorname{div}B=0\quad\text{in }\Omega
\]
{for $f$ given in the range of the curl, together with boundary conditions imposed on $B$. The solution can be found by solving the Hodge Laplace equation}
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}B-\operatorname{grad}\operatorname{div}B=f.
\]
{For time-harmonic problems, an additional zeroth order term occurs in this equation, giving a perturbed Hodge Laplace equation}
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}B-\operatorname{grad}\operatorname{div}B-m^2B=f,
\]
{where $m$ is the wave number. In magnetohydrodynamics, there is an additional first order advection term induced by the velocity vector field $v$, so in the static case we have}
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}B-\operatorname{grad}\operatorname{div}B-\operatorname{curl}(v\times B)=f.
\]
translated_text:
{静磁学中的一个基本模型问题, 是求 (向量代理) 2-形式 $B$, 使得}
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}B=f,\qquad\operatorname{div}B=0\quad\text{in }\Omega
\]
{其中给定的 $f$ 属于旋度的像, 并对 $B$ 施加边界条件. 可以通过求解 Hodge Laplace 方程得到解}
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}B-\operatorname{grad}\operatorname{div}B=f.
\]
{对时谐问题, 此方程中出现额外的零阶项, 得到扰动的 Hodge Laplace 方程}
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}B-\operatorname{grad}\operatorname{div}B-m^2B=f,
\]
{其中 $m$ 是波数. 在磁流体力学中, 还有速度向量场 $v$ 引起的额外一阶对流项, 因而静态情形下有}
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}B-\operatorname{grad}\operatorname{div}B-\operatorname{curl}(v\times B)=f.
\]

source_text: {The analysis of \BookCite{14} is quite involved, and we will only briefly summarize the main results. It is possible, of course, that the operator $L$ (including its boundary conditions) admits a kernel, just as the ordinary Helmholtz operator $-\Delta+l$ may have a kernel when $l$ is negative. Suppose that this is not the case, i.e., $0$ is not an eigenvalue of $L$, and so the continuous problem is well-posed. Then the finite element discretizations we have derived for the Hodge Laplacian, all four possibilities given in \eqref{eq:four-galerkin-form-pairs}, are stable for the perturbed operator $L$ as well, at least for sufficiently fine triangulations. The basic error estimates, as stated in Theorem~\ref{thm:mixed-basic-error}, therefore hold. The surprise comes when trying to establish the improved error estimates of Theorem~\ref{thm:mixed-improved-errors}, which establish optimal $L^2$ rates of convergence for each of the quantities $\sigma$, $d\sigma$, $u$, and $du$. It turns out that for some choices of the finite element spaces and some lower order terms $(l_1,\ldots,l_5)$ there can be a loss of one convergence order for either $\sigma$ or $d\sigma$ or both. The results are summarized in Table~\ref{tab:perturbed-hodge-error-rates}, which should be compared to Table~\ref{tab:galerkin-form-approximation-rates} (the case when all the $l_i$ vanish). These rates were all established theoretically and verified as sharp computationally in \BookCite{14}, to which we refer for details.}
translated_text: {\BookCite{14} 的分析相当复杂, 这里只简要概述主要结果. 算子 $L$ (包括其边界条件) 当然可能有核, 就像通常的 Helmholtz 算子 $-\Delta+l$ 在 $l$ 为负时可能有核一样. 假定并非如此, 即 $0$ 不是 $L$ 的特征值, 因而连续问题适定. 则为 Hodge Laplacian 导出的有限元离散化, 即 \eqref{eq:four-galerkin-form-pairs} 中的全部四种选择, 对扰动算子 $L$ 也稳定, 至少对充分细的剖分如此. 因此, Theorem~\ref{thm:mixed-basic-error} 陈述的基本误差估计成立. 意外出现在试图建立 Theorem~\ref{thm:mixed-improved-errors} 的改进误差估计时, 这些估计为 $\sigma$, $d\sigma$, $u$ 和 $du$ 各量建立最优 $L^2$ 收敛阶. 结果表明, 对有限元空间的某些选择以及某些低阶项 $(l_1,\ldots,l_5)$, $\sigma$ 或 $d\sigma$ 或两者可能损失一阶收敛阶. 结果总结于 Table~\ref{tab:perturbed-hodge-error-rates}, 应将其与 Table~\ref{tab:galerkin-form-approximation-rates} (所有 $l_i$ 均为零的情形) 比较. \BookCite{14} 在理论上建立了所有这些阶数, 并通过计算验证了其尖锐性, 细节请参见该文.}
